"I was analyzing declining gross margins on [Product/Business unit] (Situation). I built a three-statement model in [your skill] driven from unit sales, price per unit and COGS assumptions, reconciled it to historical cash flow and P&L, and tested sensitivity to price and volume while benchmarking margins against three public comps using Bloomberg data (Action). The model showed a 4% margin leak driven by rising material costs and a pricing lag; I recommended a 3-step plan (price increase on SKUs above [x%] of sales, renegotiation with top supplier for a 2–3% cost cut, and a weekly margin dashboard), which the manager approved and we recovered ~2 percentage points of margin in the next
quarter, increasing quarterly EBITDA by $[amount] (Result)."

One concrete improvement for your live answer: always state the exact metric you changed (percentage points, $ saved, time reduced) and the tool you used ([your skill], SQL, Bloomberg), then finish with the timeframe.
